page_title: EIN 3-3 DOR | Eintracht Frankfurt v Dortmund 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+4' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+4' A cross from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Referee Robert Schroder halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Edin Terzic, then shows him a yellow.
90+2' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+2' The linesman signals that Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+1' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Kevin Trapp comfortably gathers the ball.
90+1' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings his opponent down. Robert Schroder has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Dortmund.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' A cross into the box from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared.
88' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
86' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Fares Chaibi.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Philipp Max as he is replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt).
86' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is adjudged offside.
82' 3 - 3 Goal! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) scores after an assist by Karim Adeyemi that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 3:3.
79' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) commits a foul during an attacking move.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) was quite harsh and Robert Schroder didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
76' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
73' A long pass, executed by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
73' Substitution. Ansgar Knauff makes his way off the pitch and Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as his replacement.
70' Mats Hummels is substituted due to injury. Edin Terzic gives a chance to Niklas Sule (Dortmund).
68' 3 - 2 Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
67' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Kevin Trapp comfortably gathers the ball.
66' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
65' It's time for a substitution. Julian Brandt (Dortmund) comes on in place of Marco Reus.
65' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
64' The linesman raises his flag. Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is adjudged offside.
64' Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
63' This shall not pass! Marco Reus (Dortmund) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
62' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
61' That's the end of the game for Buta, who is replaced by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
59' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
58' Dangerous play by Mats Hummels (Dortmund). Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick.
57' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) is caught offside!
56' Robert Schroder sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
55' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Dortmund players aren’t happy.
54' 2 - 2 Goal! Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:2.
52' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
47' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
47' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) is coming onto the pitch as Donyell Malen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' Half-time substitution. Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) is replaced by Karim Adeyemi.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+9' Robert Schroder has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
45+7' Marco Reus pulls the ball back to Mats Hummels (Dortmund) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post.
45+6' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
45+4' Flag goes up against Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+3' A lofted cross from Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
45+2' Off the post! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range bounced off the left post.

45+1' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
45' A lofted pass into the box is met by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
42' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
41' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
39' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Eintracht Frankfurt! Play can continue.

38' There's a break in play and referee Robert Schroder must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Eintracht Frankfurt using VAR. This could be interesting!
36' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

35' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Kevin Trapp makes a comfortable save.
34' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
31' Dortmund enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
26' Edin Terzic is forced to make a change. Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is unable to continue due to injury, Alexander Meyer comes on.
24' 2 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 2:0.
24' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a shot towards the right post, but it is denied by the goalkeeper with a superb save.

24' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Gregor Kobel, who tips the ball around the post.
23' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
23' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. Dortmund are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
22' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Trapp, who smothers the ball.
21' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
21' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
19' Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is able to continue to play.
17' Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
17' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
16' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
14' Half-chance! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
11' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Schroder had an easy-decision to make.
11' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
10' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) gets on the end of the resulting free kick, but he produces a poor shot which goes well wide of the right post!
9' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Schroder blows for a foul. Dortmund will take a free kick near the side line.
8' 1 - 0 GOAL! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Gregor Kobel in goal.
8' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is going to take the penalty!
7' It’s a PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt after the VAR review!

7' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Eintracht Frankfurt.
6' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
5' A pass into the box finds Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Gregor Kobel denies him.
4' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tries to find Marcel Sabitzer with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
2' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
1' The referee blows his whistle, Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
1' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Dortmund will take the kick-off.
